- 2026-11-20 · bardo-thodol-002 establish · detail of the block above. Six independent model readers (strongest model, two per page group, crops ×2.5–×5) read pp. 18–27 from source/pages. They do not agree on how many print lines a page holds (5 or 6). Only p. 21 and parts of p. 23 come out as sound Tibetan, and even there the two readers differ on words (བྱའོ / བྱེད, ནུས / བྱས in the first two lines of p. 21). Pp. 22 (lines 2–3), 24, 25 and 26 are largely letter-guesses that do not parse. The two readers for pp. 18–20 were stopped unfinished once this was clear. The establish packet's check against the dzogchengonpa.org transcription and bo.wikipedia.org cannot be done: the cloud proxy refuses both (HTTP 403), and archive.org too, so no better image can be fetched. A text pinned from these readings would put guesses in front of the reader, so nothing was pinned. **Decided meanwhile:** all twelve parts (002–013) are blocked. 003–008 run on from 002, and 009–013 are the same print at the same resolution. Under README rule 7 the work counts as finished for the queue, so `DONE` is written and the next firing moves on to popol-vuh. The partial readings are kept in `drafts/bardo-thodol-002/readings/` for whoever resumes. **To resume:** in an attended session, or after allowing dzogchengonpa.org / bo.wikipedia.org (and archive.org) in the environment's network policy, set the parts back to `todo`, delete `DONE`, and re-establish 002 with the witness check.

- 2026-11-21 · bardo-thodol-006 · The northern realm's name. In 006 (pp. 57.5 and 60.5) the print has བྱང་ཕྱོགས་ལས་རབ་རྫོགས་པའི་ཞིང་ཁམས. ལས is read there as part of the name, *Las rab rdzogs pa* "Fully Accomplished Action", for four reasons: every other realm follows its direction with no particle; "from" would give "from … from" (u. 38) and "from the north, into the realm" (u. 20); the name answers to Amoghasiddhi's "wisdom that accomplishes deeds"; and the other recension has ལས་རབ་རྫོགས་པའི in both places. In the published 005 (u. 48, p. 53.4) the print has ལས་རབ་བརྩེགས་པའི, and 005 took ལས as "from" before a name *Rab brtsegs pa* "Heaped Up", although the other recension has ལས་རབ་རྫོགས་པའི there too. So the two parts read the same ལས differently. **Decided meanwhile:** each part follows its print; 006's note gives its reading as likely, not certain, and names the difference; 005 is left as published. **To change:** either bring 005 u. 48 into line (las as part of the name, or noted as a possible slip for las rab rdzogs pa), or say that 005's reading is wanted, and 006's u. 20, 38 and the glossary are brought into line.
